name: Mk2PVRouter Documentation
postCreateCommand: curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh -o /tmp/claude-install.sh && bash /tmp/claude-install.sh && git submodule update --init --depth 1 && pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -U -r requirements.txt && git config --global url."https://github.com/".insteadOf "git@github.com:"
postAttachCommand: gh auth setup-git 2>/dev/null || echo 'Run "gh auth login" to enable git push/pull'
